layout.note: the line stays within 2.8 m of OSM raceway ways everywhere (incl. OSM way 588780310 "IMS Grand Prix Circuit"), i.e. the 2000-2007 course is still paved; the OSM ways not followed are the oval's other turns, the 2008+ / 2014+ road-course variants, pit roads

elevation.demUsedForReference: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM (1 m lidar; ImageServer getSamples)
elevation.gameSource: USGS 3DEP via EPQS along the dataset centreline, DTM filters

published.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indianapolis_Motor_Speedway (infobox banking "Turns: 9.2 deg"); OSM way 51308226 banking=9 deg 12'

famousFeatures.real: lidar cross-slope 6.5-8.8 deg (medians of its sections; ramps at the ends), published 9.2 deg

banking.method: lidar heights at +-4 m across the OSM centreline every 10 m; tilt = atan((hLeft - hRight) / 8 m)

findings.game: curvature-derived banking on the infield corners: s 2591-2661 L R36 m (IMS Road Course): real -0.1 deg, game 4.1 (max 4.8); s 730-820 L R37 m (IMS Road Course): real 0.9 deg, game 4.3 (max 4.8); s 2511-2581 R R45 m (IMS Road Course): real 0.9 deg, game 4.1 (max 4.5); s 1711-1831 R R32 m (IMS Road Course): real 0.6 deg, game 3.5 (max 5.2)
findings.real: lidar: infield corners 13 of 13 within +-2.2 deg (straights 0.7 deg). The oval turn override is confirmed by the same method (6.5-8.8 deg vs 9.2 published), which validates the measurement
findings.proposedFix: keep the 9.2 deg override; scale the derived banking of the infield down (or use the measured cross-slope profile)
sources: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM, 1 m lidar (public domain): https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer (getSamples), acquisition dates from https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json?...&includeDate=true
game data: tracks-data.js + js/track.js built in node (devtests/track-audit/americas/game.js -> out/game-<id>.json)

findings.real: the Hulman Boulevard Pedestrian Bridge (OSM way 152842141, layer 1) spans the track at s 2117.1 m (Hulman straight); 9 tunnels / culverts pass under it (Tunnel 6 at s ~40 m, Tunnel 7 at s ~450-460 m, Tunnel 3 at s 3166, ...), invisible from the car
findings.proposedFix: add the footbridge deck at s 2117.1 m
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API (maps.mail.ru mirror), cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/

findings.real: OSM: "IMS Road Course - Pit Entry" (way 317832622) leaves on the inside before oval Turn 1 at s -761 m, "IMS Formula One Pit Lane" (way 588780329) and "IMS Pit Lane" (ways 588780264, 1176980820) run along the main straight on the right (inside) to s +421 m, "IMS Road Course - Pit Exit" (588780283) rejoins at s ~+658 m (road-course Turn 1). Pit limit for 2000-2007 not found
findings.proposedFix: side right; length is the game-wide 500 m simplification

findings.game: start at the yard of bricks
findings.real: OSM way 1213055867 "IMS Start-Finish Line" crosses the game line 0.3 m from s = 0

profile.note: s from the game line; real = lidar on the OSM foot point (30 m median); game = js/track.js sample y; tilt = lidar cross-slope (deg, + = left higher); gBank = game bank (deg, same sign)
